title: Keep the registered-launcher live fixture within Windows path and scratch-ignore limits
outcome: The registered-launcher live fixture works under representative long Windows user-temp paths and treats its owned compiler scratch consistently with the repository, without weakening real check or source-cleanliness assertions.
acceptance: Shorten the recovered-root fixture layout so the Windows owner's repository-local compiler scratch stays within its 200-character bound under a representative long user-temp path; preserve original clean-check, source-change and native receipt assertions.
Ignore only the fixture's owned .tmp compiler scratch as the repository does, and verify retained scratch does not turn an otherwise valid inner check into debris_pending_disposition.
